Add visual drag handle/grabber to floating button

Feature: Drag Handle Indicator
- Added 6-dot grabber pattern on left side of button
- Similar to JobRight and other draggable extensions
- Shows on hover to indicate button is draggable

Visual Design:
- Pattern: 6 white dots (2 columns × 3 rows)
- Using radial-gradient for clean dot pattern
- Semi-transparent white: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)
- Size: 12px wide × 18px tall

UX Behavior:
- Hidden by default (opacity: 0)
- Appears on hover (opacity: 1)
- Cursor changes: grab → grabbing when dragging
- Smooth fade transition (0.2s)

Layout:
- Positioned on far left of button
- Order: [Drag Handle] [🐷 Logo] [Text]
- Gap: 8px between elements
- Left padding adjusted to fit handle
